Godavarman
Bhaṭṭan Tampurān of Cranganore, Mahāmahopādhyāya (1858-1933 A. D.).
--C.. on C. Upahāraprakāśikā on Saparyāhṛdaya.
--Śaktitattvaprakāśikā. vedānta.
Pt.. Mangalodayam Press, Trichur.
--Siddhāntamālā. summary of Vyutpattivāda.
Pt.. Mangalodayam Press, Trichur. [Page123-b]
--C. on Prāmāṇyavāda of Gadādhara.
See Keralīyasam3skṛtasāhityacaritram Vol. V. p.. 374-7.

Godavarman
King of Vaṭakkuṅkūr in Kerala (C. 1550-1650 A. D.); patron of Aruṇagirikavi (a. of Godavarmayaśobhūṣaṇa); an. Melpputtūr Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa (a. of Bimbalīśapraśasti on the King).

Godavarman
Prince of Cochin (C. 16th Cent.). patron ref. to by Nīlakaṇṭha in his C.s on Tripuradahana an. Śaurikathodaya.
See K. Kunjunni Raja, Adyar Library Bulletin. XI. p.. 212 ff.

Godavarman
Prince of Deśiṅganāḍ, born under the asterism Śatabhiṣak; patronised by King Rāmavarma Kulaśekhara of Kerala.
--Vāsavīśāntanava. drama. No Pkt. is used here. TCD. 1213C. Triv. Cur. IV. 136.
See Contribution of Kerala to Skt. Lit. p. 224.

Godavarman
(Koṭiliṅganṛpati) of Cranganore Palace, Kerala; also known a. Yuvarāja (1800-1851 A. D.); son of Mātṛdatta of Ilakkuriśśi an. Kuññikkuṭṭi Tampurāṭṭi; student of Ārūr Mādhavan Aṭitiri an. Pantalam Subrahmaṇya Śāstrin. Vidvadyuvarājacarita by Rāmavarma Koccuṇṇi Tampurān (Pt.. Sāhitya Pariṣat-Traimāsikam, Ernakulam, Vol.. XI-XII) is a biographical poem on Godavarman.
--Āśaucadaśaka.
--Āśaucaṣoḍaśaka.

--Garuḍacayanapramāṇa. jy. [Page124-a.
--C. on Golādhyāya.

--Daśāvatāradaṇḍaka. stotra.
--Bālyudbhava or Mahendravijaya. Mahākāvya in 16 cantos.
--C. on Bhāskarīya.

Pt.. Kāvyetihāsasaṅgraha IV-V. Poona, 1888.

Godavarmayaśobhūṣaṇa

Godāvaramiśra(mahāpātra)
royal preceptor or Rājaguru an. Minister of King Gajapati Pratāparudradeva of Orissa (1497-1539 A. D.); son of Annapūrṇā an. Balabhadra of Kautsagotra (a. of Advaitacintāmaṇi an. ŚārīrakasāraPuruṣottamastuti); grandson of Narasim3hamiśra (a. of Kāśīmīmām3sā an. Sam3kṣepaśārīravārttika); an. cousin of the grandfather of Nṛsim3havājapeyin (a. of Nityācārapradīpa written under Mukundadeva Gajapati, 1559-68 A. D.); ref. to a. Vājapeyayājin an. Godāvarīvardhana.
See Des. Cat. of Skt. Mss. in Orissa Vol. I. Smṛti, Intro. p.. xviii-xxi; Orissa His.. Res. J. III. iv. p.. 188 ff.; Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p.. 470-78.
--Advaitadarpaṇa. Q. in his Hariharacaturaṅga (p. 178, verse 22; p. 216, verse 502) an. Yogacintāmaṇi.
--Adhikaraṇadarpaṇa. Q. ibid. (p. 196 verse 243).
--Ācāracintāmaṇi. Q. ibid. (p. 16, verse 502).

See also Orissa His.. Res. J. III. iv. p. 188.
--Tantracintāmaṇi. Q. in Hariharacaturaṅga (p. 156, verse 179; p. 321, verse 59) an. in Yogacintāmaṇi. [Page126-b]
--Nītikalpalatā. Q. ibid. (p. 216, verse 500).
--Nīticintāmaṇi. Q. ibid. (p. 219, verse 27).
--Pātañjaladīpikā. Q. ibid. (p. 195, verse 231).
--Yogacintāmaṇi in 20 Kiraṇas. Q. ibid. (p. 169, verse 303); also see Gode, loc. cit.
--Śāradāśaradarcana(sam3skāra)paddhati. On 2 mss. of this work see Orissa His.. Res. J. III. iv. p.. 186-96.
--Sāmudrikakāmadhenu. Q. in Hariharacaturaṅga (p. 143, verse 187).
--Hariharacaturaṅga in 8 sections. MT. 3848.
Pt.. Mad. Govt. Ori. Ser. XVII. 1950.
Mukticintāmaṇi, ascribed to his patron might probably be by this poet.
